description_full: Seacoast Banking Corporation of Florida operates as the bank holding company for Seacoast National Bank that provides integrated financial services to retail and commercial customers in Florida. The company offers noninterest and interest-bearing demand deposits, money market, savings, and customer sweep accounts; time deposits; construction and land development, commercial and residential real estate, and commercial and financial loans; and consumer loans, including installment and revolving lines, as well as loans for automobiles, boats, and personal and family purposes. It also provides wealth management, mortgage, and insurance services through mobile and online banking solutions, as well as brokerage and annuity services. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Stuart, Florida.

financial_summary: Seacoast Banking Corporation of is a mid-cap financial services business with a $3.1B market cap on $653M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +15% over the past three years and +16% annually across the full decade, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 7% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and thin 0.7× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.5% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
